name: How long does it take to install a new rocker light switch?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new rocker light switch?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install a new rocker light switch depends on the complexity of the specific job. For a straightforward replacement of an existing single-pole switch, a skilled electrician might complete the task in 15-30 minutes per switch. However, if new wiring needs to be run, or if it's part of a multi-gang box or a three-way/four-way switch setup, the installation time will increase significantly. Multiple switch installations or complex projects will naturally take longer, ranging from a few hours to a full day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for a rocker light switch varies. A simple replacement can take 15-30 minutes, but complex jobs involving new wiring or multi-switch setups will take longer.
